committee_papers.note: CMIS (DNN-based, CMIS 5.2 containers) found at this host on 2026-09-26. The current-committees page renders its list without plain links, so the planning committee id was not established. No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: YY/NNNN, with no prefix or type suffix. The detail URL takes it literally: theApnID=26/1091.

quirks.summary: The SwiftLG base path is /swift/apas/run/, not the /swiftlg/apas/run/ the recipe shows.
quirks.workaround: Take the base from the profile URL or PlanIt's planning_url.

quirks.summary: A MediaTemp PDF exists only after its showImage stub has been requested; a direct GET of ../MediaTemp/<apnkey>-<seqno>.pdf without the stub returns a 404 HTML page.
quirks.detail: The MediaTemp URL 302s to /swift/MediaTemp/<apnkey>-<seqno>.pdf. Requesting it without first fetching WCHDISPLAYMEDIA.showImage for that seqNo returned a 792-byte HTML 'not available' page; after the stub the same URL returned the PDF.
quirks.workaround: Always GET the showImage stub, parse URL= from it, then GET that URL following redirects. Check magic bytes.

quirks.summary: Document links use the WCH handler prefix (WCHDISPLAYMEDIA.showImage), not WPH.
quirks.workaround: Grep for DISPLAYMEDIA.showImage without anchoring the prefix.

pacing.note: Nine requests at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26 with no 429 or challenge.
